captions.detailed: A retractable hard-panel sunroof cassette assembly. It consists of a large, flat, dark-colored rectangular frame housing a solid grey-colored sliding panel. The sliding panel is guided on two side rails and moves prismatically backward to retract under the rear solid section of the roof cassette.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a retractable hard-panel sunroof cassette. The assembly should feature a dark outer frame with integrated guide rails and a flat, grey-colored aluminum panel designed to slide prismatically along the rails to retract under the rear roof section.
captions.factory: The sunroof is constructed as an assembly of two main parts: a base frame and a sliding panel. The frame is modeled using a wide, thin box primitive, hollowed out or subtracted to form the main sunroof opening and the solid rear cavity. The sliding panel is created from a thinner box primitive colored grey. A prismatic joint is defined between the base frame and the sliding panel, aligned along the longitudinal axis with motion limits to restrict its travel within the frame's opening.
